item.text: {"case_id":"SHC074","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C03","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 is a compelling direct template: it is the immediately preceding enlargement of the same monument, is expressly identified in the child’s recital, and supplies nearly verbatim the child’s operative sequence—adding and reserving described Colorado lands subject to the same qualifications, warning against the same unauthorized activities, and assigning the added lands to National Park Service administration under the same statute. C03 and C06 share much of this monument-enlargement machinery, but C07 uniquely matches the monument, geographic setting, qualifications, and wording.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"subject to valid existing rights and the provisions of existing withdrawals, the following-described lands in Colorado are hereby added to and reserved as a part of the Hovenweep National Monument","parent_excerpt":"subject to valid existing rights and the provisions of existing withdrawals, the following-described tracts of land in Colorado are hereby added to and reserved as parts of the Hovenweep national Monument","explanation":"Near-verbatim core disposition, including the same monument, state, saving conditions, and add-and-reserve formula."},{"child_excerpt":"Warning is hereby expressly given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, or remove any features of this monument and not to locate or settle upon any of the lands thereof.","parent_excerpt":"Warning is hereby expressly given to all unauthorized persons not to appropriate, injure, destroy, or remove any feature of this monument and not to locate or settle upon any of the lands thereof.","explanation":"Essentially identical protective warning following the land description."},{"child_excerpt":"The Director of the National Park Service, under the direction of the Secretary of the Interior, shall have the supervision, management, and control of the lands hereby added to this monument","parent_excerpt":"The Director of the National Park Service, under the direction of the Secretary of the Interior, shall have the supervision, management, and control of the lands hereby added to this monument","explanation":"Identical administrative assignment, followed in both directives by the same National Park Service Organic Act authority."}]}
